embed.description: Embedded media, external links, or quoted posts

langs.description: Languages used in the post content (ISO 639-1)

author.description: DID of the user who created this post

facets.description: Annotations for rich text (mentions, links, formatting, block structure)

content.description: Post content - supports rich text via facets

community.description: DID of the community this was posted to

crosspostOf.description: If this is a crosspost, strong reference to the immediate parent post

bridgedStats.description: Bridge-asserted aggregate of origin-platform votes for federated/bridged content. Set by the bridge that materialized this record; absent for natively-authored posts.

crosspostChain.description: Full chain of crossposts with version pinning. First element is original, last is immediate parent.

main.description: A post in a Coves community. Posts live in community repositories and persist independently of the author.

asOf.description: Timestamp the origin-platform counts were sampled; used to discard stale updates

upvotes.description: Number of upvotes on the origin platform as of asOf

downvotes.description: Number of downvotes on the origin platform as of asOf

bridgedStats.description: Aggregate vote counts asserted by the bridge for content federated from an origin platform (e.g. Lemmy). These supplement, and are kept separate from, native atproto votes.
